questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was charged with fraud for allegedly making false statements to obtain federal workers' compensation benefits. At trial, the prosecution sought to introduce an application for benefits in which the prosecution alleged that the defendant had lied about his ability to work. The defendant objected, arguing that the prosecution could not authenticate the signature on the document as his and therefore could not link the document to him. In response, the prosecution called a Department of Labor employee who was assigned to work on the defendant's file. The employee testified that after receiving a telephone inquiry from a person using the defendant's name, she mailed a letter to the defendant's home address containing instructions on how to apply for benefits. She then testified that, a week later, the application for benefits offered by the prosecution arrived by mail at her office.
Should the court admit the application?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the prosecution failed to lay a proper foundation for the application.
choices.C: Yes, because it has been properly authenticated.
choices.D: Yes, because it is a statement of the defendant's then-existing physical condition.

questions.explanation:
Authenticating documents (FRE 901)
Common methods Stipulation or eyewitness testimony
Ancient documents & data compilation
  • At least 20 years old when offered
  • condition creates no suspicion about authenticity and
  • was in place where authentic document would likely be
Public records Record was recorded or filed in public office as authorized by law or in office where that type of item is kept
Reply letter
  • Document written in response to communication and
  • contents make it unlikely response was written by someone other than recipient of first communication
Handwriting
  • Comparison – expert witness or trier of fact compares authenticated against disputed handwriting (or fingerprints, hair, cloth fibers) or
  • Non-expert opinion – witness with personal knowledge of authentic handwriting not acquired for litigation gives opinion on disputed handwriting
Self-authenticating
  • Public documents with official's signature & authorized by official or seal
  • Certified copies of public records & records of regularly conducted activities
  • Newspapers, periodicals & official publications
  • Documents with trade inscription
  • Acknowledged documents
  • Commercial papers, including signature & related documents
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Documentary and other tangible evidence is admissible provided the party seeking admission authenticates the evidence. One method of authenticating documentary evidence is to establish that the document qualifies as a reply letter. This is accomplished by showing that:

  • the document was written in response to an earlier communication and
  • the contents make it unlikely that the response was written by someone other than the recipient of the earlier communication.

This method of authentication stems from the general rule that an item's distinctive characteristics – taken together with other relevant circumstances – are sufficient to prove that the item is what the proponent claims it to be.

Here, the prosecution seeks to introduce an application purportedly submitted by the defendant. The prosecution has shown that the application was completed in response to an earlier letter sent by a Department of Labor employee to the defendant's address. The contents of the application and the circumstances surrounding its submission make it unlikely to have been written by someone other than the defendant. Therefore, the application qualifies as a reply letter. Since a proper foundation was laid, the court should admit the application (Choice B).

(Choice A) The application was authenticated as having been made by the defendant. As a result, it is excluded from the rule against hearsay as a statement of a party-opponent对方当事人陈述 (Statement by a Party-Opponent)：根据 FRE 801(d)(2)，对方当事人的陈述不属于传闻证据。.

(Choice D) Statements concerning the declarant's then-existing state of mind (eg, motive, intent, plan) or emotional/physical condition (eg, mental feeling, pain, bodily health) are excepted from the rule against hearsay. But here, no exception is necessary since the application is a nonhearsay statement of a party-opponent.

📌 Educational Objective

A document can be authenticated by establishing that it qualifies as a reply letter. To do so, the proponent must show that (1) the document was written in response to an earlier communication and (2) the contents make it unlikely that it was written by someone other than the recipient of the earlier communication.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating or identifying evidence).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告人因涉嫌作出虚假陈述以获取联邦工伤赔偿金而被控欺诈。在审判中，控方试图引入一份福利申请书，控方声称被告在该申请书中就其工作能力撒了谎。被告提出反对，认为控方无法认证文件上的签名为其本人签名，因此无法将该文件与他联系起来。作为回应，控方传唤了一名负责处理该被告档案的劳工部雇员。该雇员作证称，在接到一个使用被告姓名的人的电话咨询后，她向被告的家庭地址邮寄了一封信，信中包含了如何申请福利的说明。她接着作证说，一周后，控方出示的福利申请书通过邮件寄到了她的办公室。

法院是否应当采纳该申请书？

zh-choices.A: 不应采纳，因为它是传闻证据，且不符合任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不应采纳，因为控方未能为该申请书提供适当的证据基础。
zh-choices.C: 应采纳，因为它已经过适当的认证。
zh-choices.D: 应采纳，因为它是关于被告当时身体状况的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Authentication

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：一份文件能不能靠“回复函/回信（reply letter）”思路完成认证（authentication），让法庭认定它就是被告寄来的那份申请。

三秒认题路径：

先看文件来源 → 再看来往通信 → 内容像回信 → 够作认证 → 直接收进证据

核心法律规则

这题要背的规则

证据要先进门，先过认证（authentication）。回复函（reply letter）的考场意思：文件是对先前通信的回应，而且内容让人觉得“除了收到前信的人，不太可能是别人写的”。

这里不用把签名真伪死磕到绝对确认；distinctive characteristics 加上周边情境够用，就能把文件和被告连起来。换句话说，法庭问的是“这份申请像不像被告寄回来的回应”，不是“你能不能把每一笔签名都鉴定到百分百”。

核心判例：本题的规则就是 FRE 901 的回复函认证思路：先有前信，再看内容和情境是否足以把文件指向被告本人。

思维导图

要先问：这份申请能不能被法庭认成“就是被告的文件”？
第一步：有一封先前来信，劳动部员工先寄到被告地址，说明后续文件不是凭空冒出来。
第二步：后来寄回来的申请内容，正好回应那封前信，形成reply letter特征。
第三步：配合来往地址、时序、内容，足以认证来源。
卡死点：本题不要求先把“亲笔签名”鉴定到绝对无疑；认证标准只看是否足以让陪审团相信它是所称之物。
结论：能认证 → 证据可进 → 选 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然被告否认签名，检方就一定拿不进来。

但考试真正问的是：这份文件能不能靠回复函和周边情境完成认证，不是能不能把笔迹做到“零争议”。

司法考试看的是「能不能把文件先认出来」，而不是「每个字是不是都做了笔迹学终局鉴定」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里先有寄到被告地址的前信，后有申请回到劳动部办公室，内容又正好接上前信，reply letter特征已经够做认证（authentication）。

❌ 概念混淆 | 传闻误判

✕ A: 把认证题硬扯成传闻题了，hearsay不是这里先卡住的门。

❌ 法律适用 | 认证门槛抬高

✕ B: 误以为必须先拿到完整笔迹铁证，其实回复函情境已经能铺好基础。

❌ 事实误判 | 身体状态偷换

✕ D: 把申请表说成then-existing physical condition，完全换错证据性质。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓证据入门条件，再看能否用回复函把“文件是谁写的”这一步补齐。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先找前信，再看回信内容和情境；像回复函，就能过认证。

一眼判断：“谁寄来、回了什么、像不像本人写的”三步够了，不必先把签名争到天荒地老。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant is charged with murder. At trial, the prosecution has called a witness who heard gun shots around the time the murder occurred. The witness did not see the murder but has testified that he saw the defendant running past his bedroom window, which faces an alley near the scene of the murder. The prosecution seeks to introduce a model of the neighborhood that shows where the witness's house is located in relation to the crime scene. The witness has testified that the model accurately depicts the layout of the neighborhood on the date in question. The creator of the model was not called to testify. The defendant argues that the prosecutor has not sufficiently authenticated the model.
Is the model admissible?

choices.A: No, because demonstrative evidence prepared in anticipation of litigation must be authenticated by its creator to be admissible.
choices.B: No, because there is no evidence that a reliable process or technique was used to create the reproduction.
choices.C: Yes, because the model is self-authenticating and accurately depicts the scene it purports to represent.
choices.D: Yes, because the witness's testimony attesting to the accuracy of the model is sufficient for it to be admissible.

questions.explanation:
Authenticating physical objects (FRE 901)

Personal knowledge Testimony by witness with personal knowledge of object (or that reproduction depicts original object) • Most common method of authentication
Comparison Comparison of object or writing against authenticated specimen by expert or trier of fact
Distinctive characteristics Testimony on object's appearance, contents, substance, internal patterns, or other distinctive characteristics
Chain of custody Substantially unbroken account of object's whereabouts from time it was obtained until introduction at trial • Required method for authenticating objects that could easily be tampered with or confused with similar item (eg, blood sample)
X-ray images & electrocardiograms Evidence showing accurate process was used, machine was working properly, machine operator was qualified & chain of custody • Required method for authenticating physical representations of things that cannot otherwise be seen

FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Tangible evidence must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. Authentication requires a prima facie showing that the evidence is what the proponent claims it to be. When reproductions (eg, models, drawings, photographs, maps) are offered into evidence, they may be authenticated by the testimony of a witness with personal knowledge that the reproduction accurately depicts what its proponent claims it does.

Here, the prosecution has introduced the model as a reproduction of the neighborhood where the murder occurred. The witness lives in that neighborhood, so he has personal knowledge about the layout of the neighborhood. Therefore, his testimony attesting to the accuracy of the model was sufficient to authenticate this evidence, rendering it admissible.

(Choices A & B) A reproduction can be authenticated by having its creator testify that the reproduction process and technique produces an accurate result. However, a reproduction can also be authenticated by other means (as seen here).

(Choice C) Certain types of documentary evidence (ie, evidence in a writing or other document) are self-authenticating, but physical objects (eg, the model) are not.

📌 Educational Objective

Reproductions (eg, models, drawings, photographs, maps) may be authenticated by the testimony of a witness with personal knowledge that the reproduction accurately depicts what its proponent claims it does.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating physical objects).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告被控谋杀。在审判中，控方传唤了一名证人，该证人在谋杀发生前后听到了枪声。该证人没有看到谋杀过程，但他作证说，他看到被告跑过他的卧室窗户，该窗户朝向案发现场附近的一条小巷。控方试图引入一个社区模型，用以展示证人的房屋相对于犯罪现场的位置。证人作证称，该模型准确地描绘了事发当日社区的布局。该模型的制作者未被传唤作证。被告辩称，控方未能充分认证该模型。

该模型是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为为预期诉讼而准备的示范性证据必须由其制作者认证后方可采纳。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为没有证据表明在制作该复制品时使用了可靠的程序或技术。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为该模型是自我认证的，并准确描绘了其意图呈现的场景。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为证人证实模型准确性的证言足以使其被采纳。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Authentication

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：复现类证据（reproduction） 能不能靠有亲身了解的证人证明“这张图/这个模型像它应该像的样子”，而不是非得由制作人出庭。

三秒认题路径：

模型/地图 → 亲知证人 → 准确反映 → 901 认证过关 → 可采

核心法律规则

认证（authentication） 只要求先做出一个初步证明：这项证据就是它声称的那个东西。对模型、照片、地图、图纸（reproductions），最常见的办法就是让有亲身了解的证人作证，说它准确描绘了现场或原物。

这里的考场意思很直接：证人住在那个社区，知道街区布局，所以他能证明这个模型把案发现场附近的关系摆对了。制作人（creator） 没来，并不妨碍认证成立。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 901 - 复现类证据可以靠“亲知证人证明其准确反映”来认证，不必限定由制作人出庭。

思维导图

题干先看：这是在问 认证（authentication），还是在问证据内容真不真？
第一步：它是 模型（model），属于 复现（reproduction）。
别卡在“谁做的”上：creator 不必一定出庭。
第二步：有没有 亲身了解（personal knowledge） 的证人？
有。住在附近、知道街区布局的人，可以说这个模型“画得对”。
第三步：证人是不是在证明“准确描绘”而不是“我亲眼看见模型制作过程”？
对本题，关键是 accurately depicts，不是制作流程。
结论：认证够了 → 证据可采 → 选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然是模型，当然要看制作人有没有证明它是“靠谱工艺”做出来的。

但考试真正问的是：这个模型有没有被一个懂现场的人证明“像它声称的那样”。这题看的是「能不能先认证」，不是「谁亲手做的」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的 邻居证人 有亲身了解，已经说清这个模型准确反映街区布局，FRE 901 下认证足够，所以可采。

❌ 概念混淆 | 制作者误认

✕ A: 把 creator 当成唯一认证人了，复现类证据不是这样卡死的。

❌ 法律适用 | 技术流程误套

✕ B: 这是把要看机器流程的规则硬套到模型上了。

❌ 事实误判 | 自认证偷换

✕ C: 题干没给 self-authenticating 的条件，不能直接跳过认证。

这题建议用什么方法？

先辨认证据类型，再问“谁最懂这个东西”，复现类证据优先找亲知证人。

考场速记

记住一句：模型、照片、地图 这类复现证据，最常见的认证方法就是让有亲身了解的人说“它画对了”。

速记：不是问“谁做的”，而是问“谁能证明它像真的”。

reason.en: Identifies the exhibit as a reproduction offered to depict spatial relationships.
reason.zh: 表明该物证是用于展示空间关系的复制品。

keywords.text: accurately depicts the layout of the neighborhood

reason.en: Witness testimony on accuracy can satisfy FRE 901 for a reproduction.
reason.zh: 证人对准确性的证言可满足复制品的联邦证据规则901条认证要求。

keywords.text: creator of the model was not called to testify

reason.en: Tests whether creator testimony is the only permissible authentication method.
reason.zh: 检验是否必须以制作者证言作为唯一认证方式。

reason.en: Frames the dispositive issue as whether a prima facie authentication showing was made.
reason.zh: 将争点框定为是否已作出表面充分的认证证明。

keywords.text: witness's house is located in relation to the crime scene

reason.en: Explains why the model is offered and what the witness can personally verify.
reason.zh: 说明模型提交目的及证人可亲自核实的内容。

reason.en: Shows the witness has personal familiarity with the neighborhood layout.
reason.zh: 表明证人对社区布局具有亲身熟悉度。

A.text: demonstrative evidence prepared in anticipation of litigation

label.zh: 诉讼准备示意证据规则

reason.en: Invents a creator-only authentication requirement not required by FRE 901.
reason.zh: 虚构了联邦证据规则901条并不要求的制作者专属认证规则。

reason.en: Misstates creator testimony as the sole method for authenticating reproductions.
reason.zh: 误将制作者证言表述为认证复制品的唯一方式。

reason.en: Applies machine-or-process authentication meant for items like X-rays to a neighborhood model.
reason.zh: 将适用于X光片等证据的程序认证错误适用于社区模型。

reason.en: Triggers the wrong authentication pathway by treating all reproductions alike.
reason.zh: 因将所有复制品同等对待而触发错误的认证路径。

reason.en: Confuses document self-authentication under FRE 902 with physical model authentication.
reason.zh: 将联邦证据规则902条的文书自我认证与实物模型认证相混淆。

reason.en: Implies accuracy plus self-authentication suffices without any foundational testimony.
reason.zh: 暗示仅凭准确性和自我认证即可成立，无需任何基础证言。

D.text: witness's testimony attesting to the accuracy of the model

reason.en: States the correct FRE 901 method for authenticating this reproduction.
reason.zh: 陈述了认证该复制品的正确联邦证据规则901条方式。

D.text: sufficient for it to be admissible

reason.en: Confirms the witness's attestation meets the threshold for admission.
reason.zh: 确认证人证明已达到可采纳的门槛。

highlights.text: The witness has testified that the model accurately depicts the layout of the neighborhood on the date in question.

label.zh: 证人对模型准确性的证明

reason.en: This testimony provides the personal-knowledge foundation that authenticates the model under FRE 901.
reason.zh: 该证言提供了依据联邦证据规则901条认证模型所需的个人认知基础。

highlights.text: The creator of the model was not called to testify.

label.zh: 未传唤模型制作者作证

reason.en: Tests whether authentication fails solely because the maker did not testify.
reason.zh: 检验是否仅因制作者未作证而导致认证失败。

highlights.text: The defendant argues that the prosecutor has not sufficiently authenticated the model.

reason.en: Defines the legal issue as whether a prima facie authentication showing was made.
reason.zh: 将法律争点界定为是否已作出表面充分的认证证明。

highlights.text: model of the neighborhood that shows where the witness's house is located in relation to the crime scene

label.zh: 用于证明布局的复制品

reason.en: Triggers FRE 901 reproduction authentication rather than self-authentication or process proof.
reason.zh: 触发联邦证据规则901条对复制品的认证规则，而非自我认证或程序证明。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was tried for the homicide of a girl whose strangled body was found beside a remote logging road with her hands taped together. After the defendant offered evidence of alibi, the state calls a witness to testify that the defendant had taped the witness's hands and tried to strangle her in the same location two days before the homicide but that she escaped.
Is the evidence admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is improper character evidence.
choices.B: No, because it is unfairly prejudicial.
choices.C: Yes, as tending to show the defendant is the killer.
choices.D: Yes, as tending to show the defendant's violent nature.

questions.explanation:
Noncharacter purposes for admitting crime or bad act (MIMIC)
(MIMIC) Motive To show purpose for committing charged crime
Intent To establish guilty mind or negate good faith
Absence of Mistake To negate mistake or accident & prove deliberate act
Identity To connect defendant to crime with unique pattern of behavior (ie, criminal signature)
Common plan or scheme To show preparation or planning
Other To show knowledge of crime, opportunity to commit crime, consciousness of guilt, etc.

Evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crimes or bad acts is inadmissible if it is used to show the defendant's propensity (ie, inclination) to commit the charged crime. This ensures that the jury convicts the defendant for committing the charged crime - not for having a bad character. But evidence of a prior crime or bad act may be admissible for relevant, noncharacter purposes (ie, MIMIC ).

This includes proving the perpetrator's identity - eg, showing that the prior crimes or bad acts were committed in a unique manner that is similar in nature, location, and/or time to the charged crime (ie, criminal "signature"). Therefore, evidence that the defendant had taped the witness's hands and tried to strangle her in the same location two days before the victim's homicide is admissible as tending to show that the defendant is the killer.

(Choices A & D) The witness's testimony would be inadmissible if it was offered to prove the defendant's bad character (eg, violent nature) to show that he acted in accordance with that character and murdered the victim. But here, this evidence is being offered to prove the killer's identity and is admissible for that purpose.

(Choice B) Relevant evidence may be excluded if its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice or other concerns. Here, the witness's testimony is prejudicial to the defendant. But since that testimony is central to the case, its high probative value outweighs the risk of unfair prejudice.

📌 Educational Objective

Evidence of a criminal defendant's prior crimes or bad acts is inadmissible to show the defendant's propensity to commit the charged crime. But it may be admissible for MIMIC purposes - eg, to prove the perpetrator's identity.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) (admissibility of crimes, wrongs, or other acts).

一名被告因杀害一名女孩而受审，该女孩被勒死的尸体在一条偏远的伐木小路旁被发现，其双手被胶带捆绑。在被告提供不在场证明的证据后，控方传唤一名证人作证称，在凶杀案发生前两天，被告曾在同一地点捆绑该证人的双手并试图勒死她，但证人侥幸逃脱。

该证据是否可以采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可以，因为这是不当的品格证据。
zh-choices.B: 不可以，因为它会产生不公平的偏见。
zh-choices.C: 可以，因为它旨在证明被告是凶手。
zh-choices.D: 可以，因为它旨在证明被告的暴力本性。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Specific (Bad) Acts

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：刑事被告的先前坏行为不能拿来证明“人品差所以这次也会犯罪”，但可以为 身份（identity） 这种非品性目的入证。

三秒认题路径：

先前坏行为 → 不是品性 → 看 MIMIC → 认身份 → 可入证

核心法律规则

这题只用抓住一条线

先前犯罪或坏行为（prior bad acts）一般不能用来证明被告有坏性格、所以这次也一定会作案；考场意思：不能靠“他以前也坏”来推“他这次有罪”。

但如果证据是为了 非品性目的（noncharacter purpose），例如 身份（identity）、动机（motive）、故意（intent）或共同计划（common plan or scheme），就可能可以进来。

本题里，“同一偏僻路边、两天前、捆手并试图勒颈”的组合很像 犯罪签名（criminal signature），所以它不是在说“他性格暴力”，而是在帮忙认出谁是凶手。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 404(b) 锁定本题：坏行为证据可为非品性目的入证，尤其是用来证明身份。

思维导图

先问：这组坏行为证据，是不是想拿来证明“人品差所以会犯罪”？
如果是：
直接排除，不能靠品性推本案有罪
如果不是：
再看是不是在帮你认身份（identity）
本题事实：
同一地点 + 两天前 + 捆手 + 试图勒颈 → 这组细节高度独特，像同一人留下的“签名”。
结论：
可为认定凶手身份而入证 → 选 C
提醒：
这题不是在比“谁更坏”，而是在比“这是不是同一个人干的”。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然证人讲的是被告以前也试图勒死别人，那不就是在证明他 violent nature 吗？

但考试真正问的是：这份证据是不是在帮你锁定“谁是凶手”；这里用的是 身份（identity），不是拿坏性格去推本案有罪。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干抓到的是同一地点、同类手法的 criminal signature，这说明证据是在帮忙认定凶手身份，而不是单纯骂被告品性差。

❌ 概念混淆 | 品性推断误判

✕ A: 你把“可为身份入证”看成“只能证明坏人品”。

❌ 法律适用 | 失衡标准误判

✕ B: 只盯着不利影响，漏掉了这条证据对认身份的关键证明力。

❌ 事实误判 | 只看暴力忽略签名

✕ D: 你只看到 violent nature，没看到题干真正强调的是同一地点和同一手法。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“品性用途”和“非品性用途”，再看题干有没有独特手法把人锁回同一凶手。

考场速记

记住一句：坏行为不能证品性，但可以证 MIMIC；本题最像的是 identity，所以选能证明“他就是凶手”的那个。

顺手记口诀：MIMIC = 动机（motive）、故意（intent）、错误/意外不存在（absence of mistake）、身份（identity）、共同计划（common plan or scheme）。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant's house was destroyed by fire, and she was charged with arson. To prove that the defendant had a motive to burn down her house, the government offered evidence that the defendant had fully insured the house and its contents.
Should the court admit this evidence?

choices.A: No, because evidence of insurance is not admissible on the issue of whether the insured acted wrongfully.
choices.B: No, because the probative value of the evidence of insurance on the issue of whether the defendant intentionally burned her house down is substantially outweighed by the dangers of unfair prejudice and confusion of the jury.
choices.C: Yes, because any conduct of a party to the case is admissible when offered against the party.
choices.D: Yes, because evidence of insurance on the house has a tendency to show that the defendant had a motive to burn down the house.

questions.explanation:
Legal bases for excluding relevant evidence (FRE 402)

All relevant evidence is admissible unless excluded by a rule, law, or constitutional provision. Under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 401, evidence is relevant if:

  • it has any tendency to make a fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence (ie, probative) and
  • the fact is of consequence in determining the action (ie, material).

Here, evidence that the defendant had fully insured the house and its contents does not conclusively show that she committed the arson. But to be relevant, evidence need only have a slight tendency to make a material fact more or less probable. The insurance tends to show that the defendant had a financial motive to burn down the house. And since none of the grounds for exclusion raised in this question apply, this evidence should be admitted.

(Choice A) Under FRE 411, evidence of liability insurance or the lack thereof is inadmissible to prove negligence or wrongdoing. But such evidence is admissible for other purposes, including proof of motive.

(Choice B) A court may exclude relevant evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by certain dangers, including unfair prejudice and confusing the jury. But here, evidence of insurance poses no such danger.

(Choice C) There is no broad rule that any conduct of a party can be admitted against that party.

📌 Educational Objective

Evidence is relevant if it has even the slightest tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevancy).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告的房屋被火烧毁，她被控纵火罪。为证明被告有烧毁其房屋的动机，控方提出证据，证明被告已为该房屋及其内部物品购买了全额保险。

法院应否采纳该证据？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为关于保险的证据在被保险人是否存在不当行为的争议点上是不可采纳的。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为关于保险的证据，在其是否能证明被告故意烧毁房屋这一争议点上的证明价值，实质上被其对陪审团造成不公平偏见和困惑的危险所超过。
zh-choices.C: 应，因为案件一方当事人的任何行为，在作为对其不利的证据提出时，均可采纳。
zh-choices.D: 应，因为房屋的保险证据有助于证明被告有烧毁房屋的动机。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - General Considerations

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：保险证明（insurance evidence）能不能拿来证明动机；答案是能，因为它只是让“有烧房子动机”更可能，不是拿来证明坏人品。

三秒认题路径：

看到保险 → 想到动机 → 先过相关性 → 再看排除 → 选可采

核心法律规则

相关证据（relevant evidence）只要对一个重要事实有哪怕一点点帮助，就先算进门。FRE 401 的考场意思：它要同时满足“有一点证明力”和“这个事实对案件有用”。

保险（insurance）通常不能拿来证明某人“做坏事”，但可以拿来证明动机（motive）；考场意思：不是用保险说“她一定纵火”，而是说“她可能有钱拿，所以更可能故意烧”。

如果题目没有给你一个真正的排除理由，证据只要能让关键事实更可能，就应当进入。

核心判例： FRE 401 的基本相关性标准——只要“稍微”提高或降低重要事实的可能性，就有相关性。

思维导图

这条证据能不能进？
1. 先看相关性：保险会不会让“她有纵火动机”更可能？
会。哪怕只是微弱帮助，也先算相关。
2. 再看用途：不是拿来证明“她品行坏”，而是证明motive。
3. 排除关卡：题干没有给出足以排除的特定规则或失衡理由。
所以结论：可采，选 D。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：保险证据太“像在说她有问题”，所以应该直接排掉。

但考试真正问的是：它是不是让“有纵火动机”这件事更可能；如果答案是肯定的，它就先过相关性门槛。

关键区分：司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干的fully insured the house and its contents直接指向“有钱拿”的动机，所以这项证据能让纵火动机更可能，符合相关性。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把wrongfully当成一刀切禁用；其实这题是在问动机，不是在问过错定性。

❌ 法律适用 | 失衡标准误判

✕ B: 乱套unfair prejudice，但题干没给出足以压过证明力的排除基础。

❌ 事实误判 | 一般规则偷换

✕ C: 以为any conduct都能上；法律没有这种大口袋规则。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“证据想证明什么”，再问它是否让该事实更可能，最后才想排除规则。

考场速记

记住一句：相关性（relevance）门槛很低，动机（motive）是最常见的合法用途之一；保险证据不是天然禁区，拿来证明动机就可能进。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
The defendant, a young doctor, was charged with falsely claiming deductions on her federal income tax return. At trial, a witness testified for the defendant that she has a reputation in the community for complete honesty. After a sidebar conference at which the prosecutor gave the judge a record showing that the defendant's medical school had disciplined her for altering her transcript, the prosecutor proposed to ask the witness on cross-examination: "Have you ever heard that the defendant falsified her medical school transcript?"
Is the prosecutor's question proper?

choices.A: No, because it calls for hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because its minimal relevance on the issue of income tax fraud is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.
choices.C: Yes, because an affirmative answer will be probative of the defendant's character trait for dishonesty and, therefore, her guilt.
choices.D: Yes, because an affirmative answer will impeach the witness's credibility.

questions.explanation:
Evidence on criminal defendant's character

Inadmissible unless:
Essential element
Δ may present:
  • reputation/opinion testimony
  • SIC
Prosecution may present/rebut with:
  • reputation/opinion testimony
  • SIC
Pertinent trait
(only in criminal cases)
Δ may present:
  • reputation/opinion testimony
Prosecution may rebut with:
  • reputation/opinion testimony
  • SIC while cross-examining Δ
Δ testifies
Prosecution may show Δ's untruthfulness with:
  • reputation/opinion testimony
  • SIC (bad act & conviction) on cross-examination
  • SIC (conviction) with extrinsic evidence
Δ may rebut with:
  • reputation/opinion testimony
Δ = defendant; SIC = specific instance of conduct.

The prosecution cannot introduce evidence regarding the defendant's character unless:

  • the defendant's character is an essential element of the charged crime or an asserted defense or
  • the defendant introduces testimony on his/her own pertinent character trait (as seen here).

But if the defendant introduces such testimony (placing his/her character in issue), the door opens for the prosecution to rebut it by either:

  • calling its own witness to present reputation or opinion testimony about the defendant's pertinent trait or
  • cross-examining the defendant's character witness about a specific instance of conduct attributable to the defendant—thereby impeaching that witness's credibility.

Here, the prosecutor seeks to cross-examine the defendant's character witness about the defendant's specific instance of conduct—falsifying a medical school transcript. Since an affirmative answer will impeach the witness's credibility regarding the defendant's honest reputation, the question is proper.

(Choice A) The prosecutor's question does concern an out-of-court statement. But it does not call for hearsay since the response will be used to impeach the witness's assessment of the defendant's character—not to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (ie, that the defendant actually falsified a transcript).

(Choice B) Evidence is inadmissible when its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by its prejudicial effect. Evidence is relevant if it (1) tends to make a material fact more or less probable or (2) addresses a witness's credibility (as seen here). And since a character witness's credibility is highly relevant, the probative value of the falsified transcript would not be substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice.

(Choice C) An affirmative answer to the prosecutor's question cannot be used to prove the defendant's character trait for dishonesty and, therefore, her guilt of tax fraud. But it can be used to impeach the defendant's character witness by showing lack of knowledge of the defendant's character.

📌 Educational Objective

When a defendant introduces evidence on his/her pertinent character trait, the prosecution can rebut that evidence by (1) calling its own witness to provide reputation or opinion testimony or (2) cross-examining the defendant's character witness about a specific instance of conduct.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 404 (character evidence).

被告是一名年轻医生，她被指控在联邦所得税申报中虚报抵扣额。在庭审中，一名证人为被告作证，称其在社区中以完全诚实而闻名。在一次场边会议上，检察官向法官出示了一份记录，显示被告的医学院曾因其篡改成绩单而对其进行纪律处分。之后，检察官提议在交叉询问中问证人：“您是否听说过被告伪造了她的医学院成绩单？”

检察官的这个问题是否恰当？

zh-choices.A: 不恰当，因为它要求提供不属于任何例外情况的传闻证据。
zh-choices.B: 不恰当，因为它与所得税欺诈问题的关联性极小，且其证明价值被不公正偏见的风险实质性地超过。
zh-choices.C: 恰当，因为肯定的回答将证明被告有不诚实的品格特质，并因此证明其有罪。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Character evidence

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：被告先拿出自己“诚实”品格证据后，检方能不能用具体不诚实事例交叉询问她的品格证人。

三秒认题路径：

被告先举品格 → 检方要反击 → 问具体旧事 → 这是证人可信度 → 可以问

核心法律规则

一般来说，检方不能主动拿被告的品格证据（character evidence）来证明她“人品差，所以这次也有罪”。但如果被告自己先提出相关的相关品格特征（pertinent trait），比如这里的“诚实”，检方就能反击。

反击方式之一，是交叉询问被告的品格证人：你有没有听说过她做过某个具体不诚实行为。这里的重点不是证明那件事本身是真的，而是看这个证人对被告品格了解得够不够。

所以，问“你有没有听说她伪造过医学院成绩单”是为了打击这位品格证人的可信度，属于可问的反击问题。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 404 的思路是：被告先开门，检方才能用品格证据回击；对品格证人的具体事例发问，目的在于检验其对被告品格的了解。

思维导图

先看：被告有没有先把“诚实”这个相关品格特征（pertinent trait）放进来？
是被告先请证人说她“很诚实” → 检方可以反击。
反击方式可交叉问品格证人：具体不良行为（specific instance of conduct）你听没听过？
本题卡点“伪造医学院成绩单”不是拿来证明这次报税诈欺本身，而是打证人对她诚实品格的认识。
卡死点：这题问的是证人可信度，不是用旧事直接证明被告有罪。
结论检方这个问题可以问，选 D。
如果被告没先举品格，检方就不能这样先发制人。
普通规则不能主动拿被告品格去说“她这次也会骗人”。
本题例外门已打开，所以才轮到检方反击。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这题提到“伪造成绩单”，听起来像是在拿旧坏事证明她这次也作弊。

但考试真正问的是：检方有没有在交叉询问（cross-examination）里，用这个具体事例去拆穿品格证人的了解程度。

司法考试看的是「证据规则下能不能这样问」，而不是「那件旧事会不会让陪审团更讨厌被告」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 D？

题干里被告先请人证明自己很诚实，检方就能用伪造成绩单这类具体旧事去问品格证人，借此检验他对被告诚实形象的了解。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把这题当成hearsay，忽略了这里是问证人了解度。

❌ 事实误判 | 相关性偷换

✕ B: 只盯着报税案，忘了这里是在拆品格证人，不是直接衡量罪名轻重。

❌ 法律适用 | 用途认错

✕ C: 以为旧事能直接证明她这次有罪，把guilt和反驳证人混为一谈。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看被告有没有先开门，再判断检方是在“证明有罪”还是在“打品格证人”。

考场速记

记住一句：被告先举好品格，检方才可用具体事例去反击品格证人。这题只要看到“先有诚实证词 + 检方问旧坏事”，就想到是在考品格证人的交叉询问。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
On trial for murdering her husband, a woman testified she acted in self-defense. The woman calls a psychologist as an expert witness to testify that under hypnosis the woman had described the killing, and that in the psychologist's expert opinion the woman had been in fear for her life at the time of the killing.
Is the psychologist's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it expresses an opinion concerning the woman's mental state at the time of the killing.
choices.B: No, because reliance on information tainted by hypnosis is unconstitutional.
choices.C: Yes, because it reports a prior consistent statement by a witness (the woman) subject to examination concerning it.
choices.D: Yes, because the psychologist was able to ascertain that the woman was speaking truthfully.

questions.explanation:
Expert opinion on ultimate issue (FRE 704)
Admissible unless:
  • offered in criminal case and
  • concerns requisite mental state for charged crime or asserted defense
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

An expert witness may typically offer an opinion on an ultimate issue—ie, a point that, by itself or in conjunction with other points, is sufficient to resolve the case. But in a criminal case, an expert may not offer an opinion about whether the defendant possessed the requisite mental state for the charged crime or an asserted defense. Only the trier of fact can decide this ultimate issue.

Here, the psychologist seeks to offer his expert opinion that the woman feared for her life at the time of the killing. This opinion goes toward whether the woman possessed the requisite mental state for self-defense—ie, an actual and reasonable belief that she faced imminent death or serious harm. Therefore, the psychologist's testimony is not admissible.

(Choice B) There is no constitutional prohibition against admitting evidence obtained by hypnosis. And since it is the woman (not the prosecution) who is offering this evidence, a constitutional argument is misplaced.

(Choice C) The proffered testimony reports the psychologist's expert opinion—not the woman's prior consistent statement.

(Choice D) The psychologist may have been able to ascertain whether the woman was speaking truthfully. But this does not make the psychologist's opinion on the woman's mental state admissible.

📌 Educational Objective

An expert witness may offer an opinion on an ultimate issue except when the opinion is offered in a criminal case and concerns whether the defendant possessed the requisite mental state for a charged crime or asserted defense.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 704 (opinion on ultimate issue).
questions.zh-question:
一名女子因被控谋杀其丈夫而受审，她作证称自己是出于自卫。该女子传唤一名心理学家作为专家证人作证，称该女子在催眠状态下描述了杀人过程，并且根据该心理学家的专家意见，该女子在杀人时正为自己的生命感到恐惧。

该心理学家的证词是否可采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为它表达了关于该女子在杀人时的精神状态的意见。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为依赖经催眠污染的信息是违宪的。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为它报告了由一名证人（该女子）作出的、且该证人就此接受质证的先前一致性陈述。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为该心理学家能够确定该女子所言属实。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Opinion testimony

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：专家意见（expert opinion）虽然通常能碰 终局问题（ultimate issue），但在刑事案里，不能直接替陪审团判断被告是否具备构成自卫所需的心理状态。

三秒认题路径：

刑事案 → 专家作证 → 讲心理状态 → 触碰终局问题 → 排除

核心法律规则

联邦证据规则 704（FRE 704）下，专家证人一般可以就 终局问题（ultimate issue） 发表意见，意思是他可以把案子里最关键的结论直接说出来。

但在刑事案件中，专家不能替事实裁判者判断被告是否具备 构成犯罪所需的心理状态（requisite mental state），也不能替陪审团判断被告对抗辩是否成立的同类心理状态。

所以这题里，心理学家想说“她当时害怕到足以构成自卫”，这已经是在替陪审团判断自卫所需的心理状态，直接踩线。

核心判例： FRE 704 规则本身锁定结论：一般能碰终局问题，但刑事案里不能碰被告的必要心理状态。

思维导图

先看：专家是不是在讲“最后该怎么判”的问题？
是 继续问：这是刑事案吗？
是
再问：专家有没有直接说被告是否具有 requisite mental state？
有 这一步卡死：专家不能替陪审团判断自卫所需心理状态
结果
不能用“她怕死了”来替代陪审团自己的判断 → 选 A

考点陷阱

你可能会想：心理学家既然能分析人格、记忆和可信度，就应该能说她当时是不是在怕死。

但考试真正问的是：专家能不能直接替陪审团回答“她是否具有自卫所需的心理状态”，答案是否定的。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

这题最容易被 prior consistent statement 和“专家看起来很专业”带跑，但真正被排除的是“对心理状态下结论”的那一句，不是心理学这个职业本身。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 A？

题干专家要说她当时“怕死”，这等于直接判断自卫所需的心理状态；在刑事案里，这类终局意见不能进。

❌ 事实误判 | 题干偷换焦点

✕ B: 把 hypnosis 当成宪法禁区了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 传闻标签误贴

✕ C: 这不是在讲 prior consistent statement，而是在讲专家结论。

❌ 法律适用 | 可信度外推误判

✕ D: 会判断真话，不代表能替陪审团下 mental state 结论。

这题建议用什么方法？

先抓“终局问题”，再看是不是刑事案里的心理状态；一旦是，就直接卡掉。

考场速记

记住一句：专家可讲终局问题，但别替陪审团判被告心里怎么想。

本题速记：ultimate issue 通常能讲，requisite mental state 在刑事案里不能讲。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a suit based on a will, the distribution of $1 million depends upon whether the wife survived her husband when both died in the crash of a small airplane. An applicable statute provides that, for purposes of distributing an estate after a common disaster, there is a rebuttable presumption that neither spouse survived the other.
A witness has been called to testify that as she approached the plane she heard what she thought was a woman's voice saying, "I'm dying," although by the time the husband and wife were removed from the wreckage they were both dead.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because the matter is governed by the presumption that neither spouse survived the other.
choices.B: No, because the witness's testimony is too speculative to support a finding.
choices.C: Yes, because it is relevant and not otherwise prohibited.
choices.D: Yes, because the hearsay rule does not apply to statements by decedents in actions to determine rights under a will.

questions.explanation:
Legal bases for excluding relevant evidence (FRE 402)

FRE = Federal Rules of Evidence

To be admissible, evidence must be relevant. This means that the evidence must have some tendency to make a material fact more or less probable. Here, the outcome of the suit depends on whether the wife survived the husband. And the witness's testimony that she heard a woman's voice say, "I'm dying," as she approached the wreckage increases the likelihood that the wife outlived the husband and rebuts the statutory presumption推定：法律或规则允许在证明基础事实后，可推断另一事实成立。 that neither spouse survived the other. Therefore, the witness's testimony is relevant.

However, relevant evidence may be excluded by a specific rule, law, or constitutional provision. One ground for exclusion raised here pertains to the hearsay rule, which prohibits out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But the out-of-court statement, "I'm dying," is not hearsay since it is being used to prove that the woman could speak and so was alive when the statement was made—not to prove that she was actually dying (Choice D). Therefore, the witness's testimony is admissible.

(Choice A) Under the "bursting bubble" approach泡沫破裂法：在民事案件中，一旦对方提出足以反驳推定事实的证据，可反驳推定即“破裂”，事实认定者须依证据权衡该问题。† followed by the Federal Rules of Evidence in civil cases, a party can overcome a presumption (eg, that neither spouse survived the other) by producing sufficient contrary evidence. Once this occurs, the presumption "bursts" and no longer governs the matter.

(Choice B) The witness's testimony证言：证人基于个人知识在法庭上所作的陈述。 is not too speculative since there is no requirement that a witness be absolutely certain of matters about which he/she testifies.

†This bursting-bubble approach does not apply to conclusive presumptions or in federal diversity cases, where state law governs the effect of a presumption.

📌 Educational Objective

Evidence is only admissible if it is relevant—ie, tends to make a material fact more or less probable. But relevant evidence may be excluded by a specific rule, law, or constitutional provision (eg, the hearsay rule).

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 402 (general admissibility of relevant evidence).
questions.zh-question:
在一起基于遗嘱的诉讼中，100万美元的分配取决于在一场小型飞机坠毁事故中双双身亡的夫妻，妻子是否比丈夫生存时间更长。

一部适用的成文法规定，为在共同灾难后分配遗产之目的，存在一个可被反驳的推定，即夫妻双方均未比对方生存时间更长。

一名证人被传唤作证，称其在接近飞机时，听到她认为是女人的声音说：“我就要死了”，尽管当夫妻二人从残骸中被移出时，他们都已经死亡。

该证人的证言是否可被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不可采纳，因为此事受“夫妻双方均未比对方生存时间更长”这一推定的管辖。
zh-choices.B: 不可采纳，因为该证人的证言过于推测，无法支持一项裁定。
zh-choices.C: 可采纳，因为它具有相关性，且未被其他规则禁止。
zh-choices.D: 可采纳，因为在确定遗嘱权利的诉讼中，传闻证据规则不适用于死者的陈述。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - General Considerations

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：证人听到“I'm dying”这类陈述时，先看它是否能让“妻子是否比丈夫活得更久”更可能成立，再看它有没有被别的证据规则排除。

三秒认题路径：

相关性 → 可采性 → 传闻排除 → 结论：可进

核心法律规则

相关证据（relevant evidence） 的门槛很低，只要它对一个重要事实（material fact）有一点点“更可能/更不可能”的帮助，就先算相关。这里，法定推定（statutory presumption） 说的是共同灾难中先假定夫妻都没存活，但证人听到女人说“我快死了”，会让“妻子可能先于丈夫或至少有过存活痕迹”更可信，所以先过相关性。

但相关不等于一定能进；还要再看有没有排除规则（exclusionary rule）。这题里真正挡路的是传闻（hearsay），可这里那句话不是拿来证明“她真的快死了”，而是用来证明“她当时会说话、当时还活着”，所以不是传闻。

核心判例： 不需要特定判例也能锁定结论；按 FRE 401 和 FRE 402，先相关、再看是否被其他规则排除。

思维导图

先问：这句“I'm dying”能不能让遗产分配中的关键事实更可能成立？
YES： 影响“妻子是否比丈夫活得更久”→ 属 相关证据（relevant evidence） → 先通过 FRE 401。
再问： 有没有别的规则把它挡出去？
传闻关卡： 这句话不是为了证明“她真的在死”，而是为了证明“她当时能说话、当时活着”。
卡死点：不是拿来证“内容为真”，所以不是传闻（hearsay）。
结论： 既相关，又没有其他排除理由，答案就是 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然有“夫妻共同灾难”的推定，那证人这句话就没用了。

但考试真正问的是：这句话有没有让关键事实更可能成立；只要能帮助推翻推定，它就先是相关证据。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里 heard a woman's voice saying “I'm dying” 会让“妻子是否存活”更可能成立；又没有被别的规则挡住，所以可采。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把推定当成证据封口，忽略它本来就能被反证打破。

❌ 事实误判 | 证言确定性误判

✕ B: 证人不必百分百确定，题干也没说她只是瞎猜。

❌ 法律适用 | 传闻例外误套

✕ D: 看到 decedents 就乱套例外，但这里根本不是拿来证明话里内容为真。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with tax evasion. The prosecution alleged that the defendant failed to report income from all his rental properties on his tax returns. The defendant pleaded not guilty, claiming that he reported all his properties and the income each generated. At trial, the prosecutor seeks to introduce into evidence a copy of the state register of deeds listing the defendant as the owner of a house that was not included on his tax return. The copy is not signed, sealed, or certified. The defendant has objected to the admission of the state register of deeds on the ground that it has not been properly authenticated.
Should the court admit the register of deeds?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, unless the prosecutor introduces evidence that the register was recorded or filed in a public office or that the register is from the office where items of that kind are kept.
choices.C: Yes, because the register is self-authenticating despite not being signed, sealed, or certified.
choices.D: Yes, provided the prosecutor offers testimony detailing the chain of custody for the register.

questions.explanation:
Authenticating documents (FRE 901)
Common methods Stipulation or eyewitness testimony
Ancient documents & data compilation
  • At least 20 years old when offered
  • condition creates no suspicion about authenticity and
  • was in place where authentic document would likely be
Public records Record was recorded or filed in public office as authorized by law or in office where that type of item is kept
Reply letter
  • Document written in response to communication and
  • contents make it unlikely response was written by someone other than recipient of first communication
Handwriting
  • Comparison – expert witness or trier of fact compares authenticated against disputed handwriting (or fingerprints, hair, cloth fibers) or
  • Non-expert opinion – witness with personal knowledge of authentic handwriting not acquired for litigation gives opinion on disputed handwriting
Self-authenticating
  • Public documents with official's signature & authorized by official or seal
  • Certified copies of public records & records of regularly conducted activities
  • Newspapers, periodicals & official publications
  • Documents with trade inscription
  • Acknowledged documents
  • Commercial papers, including signature & related documents
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Documentary evidence must be authenticated before it can be admitted into evidence. This requires that the proponent produce evidence sufficient to support a finding that the document is what the proponent claims it is. Public records that do not qualify for self-authentication (as seen here) may still be authenticated through evidence that the document:

  • was recorded or filed in a public office as authorized by law or
  • is from the office where items of that kind are kept.

Here, the prosecutor seeks to introduce the state register of deeds (public record) listing the defendant as the owner of a house that was not included on his tax return. But the register must be properly authenticated before it can be admitted. And since the register is not self-authenticating, the court should not admit it unless the prosecutor can provide evidence that the register was recorded or filed in a public office or is from the office where items of that kind are kept.

(Choice A) The rule against hearsay bars the admission of out-of-court statements (eg, register of deeds) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, ownership of house). However, an exception to this rule applies to existing public records现存公共记录（FRE 803(8)）：公共机关或机构的记录或陈述，可作为传闻证据例外采纳。 (as seen here).

(Choice C) A public record is self-authenticating自我认证（FRE 902）：经核证副本、带公章的公共文件等，无需额外认证 foundation 即可采纳。 only if it is:

  • (1) certified as correct by a custodian or person authorized to do so,
  • (2) sealed and signed by a government entity, or
  • (3) signed by an employee of the government entity whose signature is certified as genuine by another public officer (not seen here).

(Choice D) Chain of custody保管链：用于认证容易被篡改或不易识别的实物证据（如枪支、刀具、血样）。 must be used to authenticate physical evidence that could easily be tampered with or is not readily identifiable – eg, gun, knife, blood sample. Here, the copy of the register of deeds is unlikely to have been tampered with, as there is an original for comparison, and it is readily identifiable. Therefore, chain-of-custody authentication is unnecessary.

📌 Educational Objective

Public records may be authenticated through evidence that the document:

  • (1) was recorded or filed in a public office as authorized by law or
  • (2) is from the office where items of that kind are kept.
📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 901(b)(7) (authenticating or identifying public records).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 902(4) (certified copies of public records).

一名被告被指控逃税。控方指控该被告未在其纳税申报单中报告其所有出租物业的收入。被告不认罪，声称他已报告其所有物业及其产生的收入。在庭审中，检察官试图引入一份州地契登记册的副本作为证据，该副本将被告列为一处未包含在其纳税申报单上的房屋的所有人。该副本未经签署、盖章或认证。被告以未经适当认证为由，反对采纳该州地契登记册。

法院是否应采纳该地契登记册？

zh-choices.A: 不应采纳，因为它是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不应采纳，除非检察官出示证据证明该登记册是在公共部门记录或存档的，或者该登记册来自保管此类文件的部门。
zh-choices.C: 应采纳，因为该登记册是自我认证的，尽管其未经签署、盖章或认证。
zh-choices.D: 应采纳，前提是检察官提供证言详细说明该登记册的保管链。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Authentication

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：公共记录（public records）拿来法庭前，先看它有没有被正确认证；这题问的是“能不能作为这份文件上法庭”，不是先纠缠它说了什么。

三秒认题路径：

公共记录 → 先认证 → 非自认证 → 补基础 → 才能入证

核心法律规则

只看本题要用的规则

文件认证（authentication）的门槛是：先拿出足够证据，让法官相信“这就是它自称的那份文件”。公共记录（public records）如果不是自我认证（self-authenticating），就还得补一层基础：证明它是被依法存入公职处，或者来自平时保存这类材料的办公室。

所以这题里，未签名、未盖章、未认证的县地契登记副本，不能直接因为“看起来像公共记录”就进证据。考试上你要抓的是：recorded or filed in a public office 或 from the office where items of that kind are kept 这两个认证入口。

核心判例： Fed. R. Evid. 901(b)(7) 与 902(4) 锁定本题：未经认证的公共记录副本，不能因为是公共记录就自动入证。

思维导图

先问：这份地契登记副本能直接入证吗？
1. 这是公共记录（public record），但题干已说它未签名、未盖章、未认证，所以不是自我认证（self-authenticating）那一类。
2. 既然不是自认证，就要补认证基础（authentication foundation）：要么证明它recorded or filed in a public office，要么证明它来自保存这类文件的办公室。
3. 题干没有给这层基础，所以现在不能直接接纳。
结论：先补认证基础，再谈能不能进证据。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这明明是政府出的登记簿，应该天然可靠，所以可以直接用。

但考试真正问的是：这份文件有没有先过“认证”这道门，而不是它讲的内容真不真。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。 这一题也一样，看的是这份副本能不能被法庭认定为它自称的那份文件，不是它背后事实有多像真的。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干的关键点是这份公共记录副本没有签名、盖章或认证，所以要先证明它已被依法存档或来自该办公室，才能入证。

❌ 概念混淆 | 传闻误判

✕ A: 把认证题错当成hearsay题，先后顺序搞反了。

❌ 法律适用 | 自认证误判

✕ C: 以为self-authenticating，但题干缺少签名、盖章或认证副本。

❌ 事实误判 | 保管链偷换

✕ D: 把文件副本硬说成chain of custody管的实物证据。

这题建议用什么方法？

先判它是不是自认证公共记录；不是的话，就立刻补认证基础，别急着跳到传闻或保管链。

考场速记

记住一句：公共记录不等于自动能进证据，先看能不能认证，不能就找 recorded or filed in a public office 或 from the office where items of that kind are kept。

这题的速记就是：公共记录先认证，自认证看签章，没过门槛别急着谈内容。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A plaintiff, after his multi-story building collapsed, sued his insurance company for the proceeds owed under the insurance policy. The plaintiff alleges that lightning struck a structural support beam and caused the building to collapse. The insurance company contends that the collapse was a result of the plaintiff overloading the support beam by installing a gym on the top floor of the building.
At trial, the plaintiff produced an incident report that identified charring on the support beam. To explain the charring, the insurance company seeks to introduce an affidavit given by a journalist over 40 years ago. The affidavit describes a fire that occurred in the building at that time, while the building was still under construction. The insurance company called the editor of the local newspaper, who testified that the journalist's affidavit was kept in the article archives and is in the same condition as the articles it was stored with. The editor further testified that the newspaper has always archived articles and supporting documents as soon as the article is published.
If the insurance company offers the journalist's affidavit into evidence, is it likely to be admitted?

choices.A: No, because the affidavit contains hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because the affidavit is not based on the editor's personal knowledge.
choices.C: Yes, because the editor testified as to the authenticity of the affidavit.
choices.D: Yes, because the editor's testimony established the chain of custody for the affidavit.

questions.explanation:
Authenticating documents (FRE 901)
Common methods Stipulation or eyewitness testimony
Ancient documents & data compilation
  • At least 20 years old when offered
  • condition creates no suspicion about authenticity and
  • was in place where authentic document would likely be
Public records Record was recorded or filed in public office as authorized by law or in office where that type of item is kept
Reply letter
  • Document written in response to communication and
  • contents make it unlikely response was written by someone other than recipient of first communication
Handwriting
  • Comparison – expert witness or trier of fact compares authenticated against disputed handwriting (or fingerprints, hair, cloth fibers) or
  • Non-expert opinion – witness with personal knowledge of authentic handwriting not acquired for litigation gives opinion on disputed handwriting
Self-authenticating
  • Public documents with official's signature & authorized by official or seal
  • Certified copies of public records & records of regularly conducted activities
  • Newspapers, periodicals & official publications
  • Documents with trade inscription
  • Acknowledged documents
  • Commercial papers, including signature & related documents
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Documentary evidence, like other tangible evidence, must be authenticated before it can be admitted into evidence. This is commonly done by stipulation or eyewitness testimony. However, an "ancient document" or data compilation can also be authenticated by showing that it:

  • is at least 20 years old at the time it is offered
  • is in a condition that creates no suspicion about its authenticity and
  • was found in a place where it would likely be if it were authentic.

Here, the journalist's affidavit is over 40 years old. The editor testified that it is in the same condition as the articles it was stored with and was kept in the newspaper's archives where similar documents are stored. Since this testimony shows that there is no suspicion about the affidavit's authenticity, it was properly authenticated. As a result, it is admissible unless another exclusionary rule applies.

One such rule is the rule against hearsay, which generally bars the admission of out-of-court statements (eg, those in the affidavit) offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein (eg, that the building previously caught fire). However, statements in ancient documents prepared before January 1, 1998 are excepted from this rule, so the affidavit will likely be admitted (Choice A).

(Choice B) The rule for authenticating ancient documents was created to address problems caused when firsthand witnesses die, recollections fade, or alternative evidence is lost with the passage of time. As a result, ancient documents need not be authenticated by someone with personal knowledge of its creation.

(Choice D) Chain of custody保管链：用于证明实物证据（如枪支、血样）在收集至呈庭期间未被篡改或调换的认证方式。 must be used to authenticate physical evidence – as opposed to documentary evidence – that could easily be tampered with or is not readily identifiable (eg, gun, knife, blood sample).

📌 Educational Objective

An ancient document can be authenticated by showing that the document (1) is at least 20 years old when offered, (2) is in a condition that creates no suspicion about its authenticity, and (3) was found in a place where it would likely be if it were authentic.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating ancient documents).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 803(16) (hearsay exception for statements in ancient documents).
questions.zh-question:
一名原告，在其多层建筑倒塌后，起诉其保险公司，要求支付保险单项下的赔偿金。原告声称，闪电击中了一根结构支撑梁，导致建筑物倒塌。保险公司主张，倒塌是由于原告在建筑物顶层安装健身房，导致支撑梁超载所致。

在审判中，原告出示了一份事故报告，该报告指出了支撑梁上的炭化痕迹。为解释这些炭化痕迹，保险公司试图引入一名记者在40多年前提供的一份宣誓书作为证据。该宣誓书描述了当时建筑物发生的一场火灾，那时建筑物仍在建设中。保险公司传唤了当地报纸的编辑作证，编辑作证称，该记者的宣誓书保存在报社的文章档案库中，其状况与一同存放的其他文章相同。编辑进一步作证称，报社总是在文章发表后立即将其与相关证明文件一同存档。

如果保险公司将该记者的宣誓书作为证据提交，它是否可能被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为该宣誓书包含传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为该宣誓书并非基于编辑的亲身认知。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为编辑就该宣誓书的真实性作了证。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为编辑的证词为该宣誓书建立了保管链。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Declarant's Availability Immaterial

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：古文档（ancient document）的认证规则和其传闻例外，和原作者现在能不能出庭没有关系。

三秒认题路径：

40年以上旧文件 → 存档地点合理 → 无伪造疑点 → 认证成立 → 可采

核心法律规则

这题只要抓住这条线

文书证据先要完成认证（authentication），考场意思：先证明“这份东西就是它自称的那份”。对古文档（ancient document），FRE 901允许只看三件事：满20年、外观和保存状态没有可疑之处、而且是在它本来就可能出现的地方找到的。这里再加上FRE 803(16)的古文档传闻例外，文件一旦真是古文档，内容通常也能进来。

核心判例： 本题考的是 FRE 901 的古文档认证逻辑，不需要原始见证人出庭；像 ancient document 这种情形，真正看的不是作者现在在不在，而是文件本身是否值得信。

思维导图

先问：这份 40 多年前的宣誓书，能不能先过 authentication？
1.是不是 20 年以上 的文件？
是：古文档门槛通过
2.保存状态有没有可疑点？
没有：和报社档案同样保存，外观正常
3.是不是放在它本来就该在的地方？
是：一直存于报纸档案库
4.结果：
认证成立 → 再加古文档传闻例外 → 选 C
陷阱：别把“作者没来”当成致命点；古文档规则就是为了解决firsthand witnesses die 这种时间流失问题。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：这份宣誓书是传闻，作者没出庭，所以不能用。

但考试真正问的是：这份文件先有没有被认证（authentication），而不是原作者今天能不能上台作证。

司法考试看的是「证据规则上能不能救济」，而不是「原作者现在有没有亲自到场」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
In a civil action for breach of an oral contract, the defendant denied having entered into a contract with the plaintiff, although he admitted that he had discussed doing so.
Which of the following standards of admissibility should the court apply to evidence proffered as relevant to prove whether a contract was formed?

choices.A: Whether a reasonable juror would find the evidence determinative of whether the contract was or was not formed.
choices.B: Whether the evidence has any tendency to make the fact of contract formation more or less probable than without the evidence.
choices.C: Whether the evidence is sufficient to prove, absent contrary evidence, that the contract was or was not formed.
choices.D: Whether the evidence makes it more likely than not that a contract was or was not formed.

questions.explanation:
Under Federal Rule of Evidence 401, relevant evidence is admissible unless it is barred by law or other evidentiary rules. Evidence is relevant if it has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence. A fact is material if it is of consequence in determining the outcome of the case.

In a breach-of-contract dispute, a material fact is the formation of a contract. Therefore, the standard of admissibility the court should apply in this case is “whether the evidence has any tendency to make the fact of contract formation more or less probable than without the evidence” (Choice B).

(Choices A & C) Whether evidence is admissible is a preliminary question for the court to decide. If the evidence is admitted, then the jury must decide if the evidence is sufficient to prove or determinative of whether a contract was formed.

(Choice D) The preponderance standard—eg, whether the evidence makes it more likely than not that a contract was formed—is the burden of proof that juries must apply to admitted evidence in most civil cases.

📌 Educational Objective

The test for relevancy is whether the evidence has any tendency to make a material fact more or less probable than it would be without that evidence.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).

zh-choices.B: 该证据是否有任何倾向，使得合同成立这一事实，比没有该证据时显得更可能或更不可能。
zh-choices.C: 在没有相反证据的情况下，该证据是否足以证明合同已经成立或未成立。
zh-choices.D: 该证据是否使得合同成立比不成立更有可能。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - General Considerations

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：相关证据（relevant evidence）的门槛标准，问的是证据有没有一点点帮助证明合同是否成立，不是问它能不能单独把案子证明完。

三秒认题路径：

合同是否成立 → 证据相关性 → 有无一点帮助 → 选 401 标准 → 选 B

核心法律规则

相关证据（relevant evidence）的考场意思：只要证据对某个重要事实（material fact）有一点点倾向性，让它“更可能”或“更不可能”，就够了。联邦证据规则 401（Federal Rule of Evidence 401）问的是相关性门槛，不是最终能不能把事实证明到位。

在违约纠纷里，合同是否成立（formation of a contract）就是重要事实，所以法官先看这份证据有没有任何倾向去影响“合同到底有没有形成”。只要有这个倾向，就可能进门；进门以后，陪审团再决定它有多有说服力。

核心判例：Federal Rule of Evidence 401的测试是：证据是否有任何倾向，使重要事实比没有这份证据时更可能或更不可能成立。

思维导图

先看这题在问什么：不是“能不能证明赢”，而是“能不能进门”。
事实触发：双方谈过要不要签合同，但被告否认已经成立。
法律关卡：401 相关性只看有没有任何倾向，能让“合同形成”更可能或更不可能。
卡死点：不要求“合理陪审员会认定”“证明充分”“优势证据”。
结论：能帮助判断合同是否形成的证据，就满足相关性门槛，答案锁定 B。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然这题是民事合同纠纷，那是不是要看证据能不能“证明到位”，或者看理性陪审员会不会直接被说服。

但考试真正问的是：相关性（relevance）的门槛，不是证明责任；法官先管“能不能进”，陪审团才管“分量够不够”。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干要证明的是合同是否形成，所以只要证据对这个事实有任何倾向性，就够过 401 的门槛。

❌ 概念混淆 | 证明门槛误判

✕ A: 把相关性错当成最终说服力，determinative 太高了。

❌ 法律适用 | 证明责任误判

✕ C: 这是在讲证据要不要“足以证明”，不是相关性的入门标准。

❌ 事实误判 | 优势证明误读

✕ D: 把 more likely than not 当成相关性，直接把门槛抬成证明标准。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“进不进门”与“证不证得赢”，相关性只看有没有一点帮助。

考场速记

记忆口诀：相关性不是“证成败”，只问“有无一点帮助”。看到 Rule 401，先找“更可能/更不可能”，不要误切到证明责任。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant was tried on multiple counts of bank fraud for a scheme in which he allegedly made withdrawals from the bank accounts of others by using false identification cards and forging signatures on checks. A codefendant, who had assisted the defendant in 5 of the 75 transactions for which the defendant was being tried, testified that he was present and saw the defendant endorse 5 of the checks.
Thereafter, the prosecutor moved for admission of all 75 checks that the defendant had allegedly endorsed, arguing that a comparison by the jury of the signatures on the checks identified by the codefendant with those on the other 70 checks would demonstrate that they were all signed by the defendant.
Should the court permit the proposed comparison of the handwriting specimens by the jury?

choices.A: No, because such a comparison may be done only by an expert.
choices.B: No, because such a comparison may be done only by an expert or by a non-expert who can testify to the genuineness of the handwriting.
choices.C: Yes, because the jurors are allowed to determine the genuineness of handwriting specimens based on comparison with authenticated specimens.
choices.D: Yes, but only if the court first makes a preliminary finding of authenticity as to the other 70 checks.

questions.explanation:
Authenticating documents (FRE 901)
Common methods
  • Stipulation or eyewitness testimony
Ancient documents & data compilation
  • At least 20 years old when offered
  • condition creates no suspicion about authenticity and
  • was in place where authentic document would likely be
Public records
  • Record was recorded or filed in public office as authorized by law or in office where that type of item is kept
Reply letter
  • Document written in response to communication and
  • contents make it unlikely response was written by someone other than recipient of first communication
Handwriting
  • Comparison – expert witness or trier of fact compares authenticated against disputed handwriting (or fingerprints, hair, cloth fibers) or
  • Non-expert opinion – witness with personal knowledge of authentic handwriting not acquired for litigation gives opinion on disputed handwriting
Self-authenticating
  • Public documents with official's signature & authorized by official or seal
  • Certified copies of public records & records of regularly conducted activities
  • Newspapers, periodicals & official publications
  • Documents with trade inscription
  • Acknowledged documents
  • Commercial papers, including signature & related documents
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Documentary evidence (eg, letter, writing) must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. Authentication requires the proponent to produce sufficient evidence to support a finding that the thing is what the proponent claims it to be. Documentary evidence is commonly authenticated by stipulation, eyewitness testimony, or handwriting verification. There are two methods of verifying handwriting:

  • Non-expert opinion – a lay witness with personal knowledge of the claimed author's handwriting (not acquired for the current litigation) testifies as to whether a document is in the author's handwriting
  • Comparison – an expert witness or the trier of fact compares the writing in question with another writing that has been authenticated

Here, the first 5 checks were authenticated through the codefendant's lay testimony that he personally saw the defendant endorse them (non-expert-opinion method). This means that the jurors, as the triers of fact, can now determine the genuineness of the 70 remaining checks by comparing them with the 5 authenticated checks (comparison method) (Choices A & B). The court should therefore permit the proposed comparison.

(Choice D) If some evidence is found to be genuine (ie, authenticated), the judge need not make a preliminary finding of authenticity as to the remainder. Instead, the jury or expert witness can make the determination.

📌 Educational Objective

Documentary evidence can be authenticated by two methods of handwriting verification: (1) a lay witness with personal knowledge of the claimed author's handwriting testifies about it or (2) an expert witness or the trier of fact compares the writing in question with another authenticated writing.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating/identifying evidence).
questions.zh-question:
一名被告因一项涉及银行欺诈的计划而受到多项指控的审判，在该计划中，他被指控使用虚假身份证并在支票上伪造签名，从他人银行账户中取款。一名同案被告，曾在被告受审的75笔交易中的5笔中协助过被告，作证称他在场并看到被告在该5张支票上背书。

此后，检察官请求采纳所有75张据称由被告背书的支票作为证据，其理由是，由陪审团将被告同案犯指认的支票上的签名与另外70张支票上的签名进行比较，将证明所有支票均由该被告签署。

法院是否应准许陪审团对笔迹样本进行拟议的比较？

zh-choices.A: 不应准许，因为此类比较只能由专家进行。
zh-choices.B: 不应准许，因为此类比较只能由专家或能够就笔迹真实性作证的非专家进行。
zh-choices.C: 应准许，因为陪审员被允许通过与经认证的样本进行比较来确定笔迹样本的真实性。
zh-choices.D: 应准许，但前提是法院首先对另外70张支票的真实性作出初步裁定。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Authentication

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：认证（authentication）时，已经被证真的签名样本，能不能让陪审团拿来比对剩下的手写签名。

三秒认题路径：

先认证样本 → 陪审团比对 → 认定真伪 → 不是只能专家 → 选 C

核心法律规则

书证进庭前先过认证（authentication），考场意思：对方先拿出足够证据，让法官相信“这就是他主张的东西”。签名比对（comparison）是认证方法之一，考场意思：事实裁判者（trier of fact）可以把争议签名和已经认证过的签名放一起看。

另一条路是非专家意见（non-expert opinion），考场意思：熟悉该人笔迹的普通证人可以说“像不像”；但一旦已经有认证样本，陪审团自己也能比对，不必等专家先出场。

核心判例： Federal Rule of Evidence 901 — 这里锁定的就是“已认证样本 + 陪审团比对”可以完成认证。

思维导图

① 先有认证样本
共犯亲眼看见被告在 5 张支票上签名，这 5 张先被证真。
② 再做签名比对
陪审团把这 5 张已认证支票，和另外 70 张争议支票放在一起看。
③ 裁判者可以自己看
规则允许 陪审团（jury） 直接比较，不要求只能专家。
④ 不必先全都认证
法官不需要先对那 70 张再逐张作额外初步认证。
⑤ 结论
因此应允许把 70 张与已认证样本做比较，支持认证成立，答案选 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然是看笔迹，就一定要专家先鉴定。

但考试真正问的是：事实裁判者（trier of fact）能不能拿已认证样本自己比对，不是只能靠专家。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里前 5 张支票已由共犯亲眼见证而认证，jurors compare with authenticated specimens 这条路就打开了，所以可以比对其余 70 张。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把比对误当成只能靠 expert 的活。

❌ 法律适用 | 证人身份误判

✕ B: 误以为只有非专家亲证笔迹时才可比对。

❌ 事实误判 | 额外认证偷加

✕ D: 先给其余 70 张再做初步认证，题干没这个门槛。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找已认证样本，再看是否允许裁判者直接比对，不要把“认证”误写成“必须专家先看”。

考场速记

记忆口诀：先认证样本，再让陪审团比对。看到手写认证题，先问“有没有已认证的对照件”，有的话就直接想comparison by the trier of fact。

reason.en: His eyewitness testimony authenticates the first five checks.
reason.zh: 其目击证言用于认证前五张支票。

keywords.text: saw the defendant endorse 5 of the checks

reason.en: Provides sufficient evidence to authenticate specimens for comparison.
reason.zh: 为比对提供已认证的书写样本。

reason.en: Triggers whether all checks must be authenticated before comparison.
reason.zh: 决定是否须先认证全部支票再比对。

reason.en: Directly tests who may compare disputed handwriting under FRE 901.
reason.zh: 直接考查联邦证据规则901下谁可进行笔迹比对。

reason.en: Their genuineness depends on comparison with authenticated writings.
reason.zh: 其真伪须通过与已认证笔迹比对确定。

reason.en: The writings that must be authenticated before substantive use.
reason.zh: 在实体使用前须先认证的笔迹材料。

reason.en: Incorrectly excludes the trier of fact from performing comparison.
reason.zh: 错误排除事实认定者进行比对。

B.text: only by an expert or by a non-expert who can testify to the genuineness of the handwriting

reason.en: Confuses lay-opinion testimony with the separate comparison method.
reason.zh: 混淆非专家意见证言与独立比对方法。

C.text: jurors are allowed to determine the genuineness

reason.en: States the correct FRE 901 rule that the trier of fact may compare writings.
reason.zh: 正确表述事实认定者可比对笔迹的规则。

reason.en: Comparison requires a properly authenticated baseline writing.
reason.zh: 比对须以已适当认证的基准笔迹为前提。

reason.en: Misstates that the judge must authenticate every remaining check before jury comparison.

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with war crimes. The prosecution alleges that, before immigrating to the United States under an alias, the defendant was a high-ranking official in a brutal foreign regime. At trial, the prosecution seeks to introduce a diamond-encrusted pendant found among the defendant's possessions after his arrest. The prosecution claims that such pendants were only given to high-ranking officials of the regime.
The defendant has objected to the introduction of the pendant, arguing lack of authentication. In response, the prosecution has produced a pendant obtained from a human rights museum, which has been authenticated as formerly belonging to a general of the regime. The prosecution has requested that both pendants be conditionally admitted so that the jury can compare them.
Should the court admit the pendants?

choices.A: No, because comparison of the pendants for authentication purposes must be done by an expert.
choices.B: No, because the authenticity of physical evidence must be established by testimony of a witness with personal knowledge of the object.
choices.C: Yes, because the jury may properly compare the pendants for authentication purposes.
choices.D: Yes, provided the court is satisfied the pendants are of sufficient similarity to allow for jury comparison.

questions.explanation:
Authenticating physical objects (FRE 901)
Personal knowledge Testimony by witness with personal knowledge of object (or that reproduction depicts original object) • Most common method of authentication
Comparison Comparison of object or writing against authenticated specimen by expert or trier of fact
Distinctive characteristics Testimony on object's appearance, contents, substance, internal patterns, or other distinctive characteristics
Chain of custody Substantially unbroken account of object's whereabouts from time it was obtained until introduction at trial • Required method for authenticating objects that could easily be tampered with or confused with similar item (eg, blood sample)
X-ray images & electrocardiograms Evidence showing accurate process was used, machine was working properly, machine operator was qualified & chain of custody • Required method for authenticating physical representations of things that cannot otherwise be seen

FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

A physical object must be authenticated before it can be admitted at trial. Authentication requires a prima facie showing that the object is what the proponent claims it to be. One method of authentication involves comparing an object that the proponent seeks to admit (defendant's pendant) with one that has been authenticated as genuine (museum's pendant). The comparison may be made by an expert or the trier of fact (Choice A). Therefore, the court should admit both pendants so that the jury, as the trier of fact, can compare them.

(Choice B) An object can be authenticated by testimony from a witness with personal knowledge of the object, but this is not the only available method of authentication.

(Choice D) There is no requirement that the court be satisfied that the items are of sufficient similarity to allow for jury comparison. However, as a practical matter, the items will often bear strong similarities.

📌 Educational Objective

A physical object may be authenticated by comparison to another that has been authenticated as genuine. Such a comparison may be made by either an expert or the trier of fact.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 901 (authenticating or identifying evidence).

被告对呈交该吊坠提出反对，理由是缺乏认证。作为回应，控方出示了一枚从人权博物馆获得的吊坠，该吊坠已被认证为曾属于该政权的一位将军。控方请求有条件地接纳这两枚吊坠，以便陪审团可以进行比较。

法院是否应接纳这些吊坠？

zh-choices.A: 不应，因为出于认证目的对吊坠进行的比较必须由专家进行。
zh-choices.B: 不应，因为实物证据的真实性必须由对该物品有亲身认知的证人通过证言来确立。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Authentication

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：物证认证（authentication）里，能不能把一件已认证真品拿来和另一件物品做比较，让陪审团自己认定真伪。

三秒认题路径：

物证认证 → 真品对照 → 陪审团可比 → 不限专家 → 选 C

核心法律规则

只看这一条就够

物证认证（authentication）要求先做一个初步证明：这件东西就是主张方说的那件东西。比较认证（comparison）是合法方法之一，考场意思：把被提议采纳的物品，和一件已经被认证为真品的样本放在一起比。这个比较可以由专家（expert）做，也可以由事实裁判者（trier of fact）做，也就是陪审团自己比。

核心判例： FRE 901 的比较认证规则直接锁定本题：既不要求必须是专家，也不要求法官先认定两件东西“足够相似”才准比。

思维导图

先问：这是不是在做物证认证？
是 题干给了一个已经认证过的“样本” pendant，想拿来比另一件 pendant。
关卡 1 比较认证（comparison）允许把真品和待认证物放一起比。
关卡 2 比较者不只限于专家，陪审团作为事实裁判者也可以比。
关卡 3 法官不必先要求“高度相似”才让比对发生；题目要的是先让陪审团看，再决定信不信。
结论 两件 pendant 都可以条件性采纳，让陪审团比较后决定真伪，答案选 C。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然是“鉴定真伪”，那就一定得找专家来做。

但考试真正问的是：比较认证（comparison）本来就能由trier of fact完成，不是专家专属。

这题看的是「谁能做认证」，不是「法官先不先替陪审团把相似性审完」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干给了已认证的museum pendant作样本，陪审团可以直接拿它和被告的 pendant 比较来完成认证。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把比较认证误当成expert only。

❌ 法律适用 | 个人知情错套

✕ B: 只盯着personal knowledge，漏掉还有比较认证这条路。

❌ 事实误判 | 相似门槛偷加

✕ D: 题目没要求先证明sufficient similarity才准比。

这题建议用什么方法？

先找认证方式，再看题干是不是已经给了“真品样本 + 可比对物”，有就直接进比较认证。

考场速记

记住：物证认证（authentication）不只靠目击者，比较认证（comparison）里陪审团也能当比较者。口诀：先找真品样本，再看谁来比，trier of fact 也可以。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
At a student's trial for stealing an automobile, the student called his college professor as a character witness. The professor testified that the student had an excellent reputation for honesty. In rebuttal, the prosecutor calls one of the student's classmates to testify that he recently saw the student cheat on a college examination.
Is the classmate's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it has no probative value on any issue in the case.
choices.B: No, because the student's cheating can be inquired into only on cross-examination of the college professor.
choices.C: Yes, because the cheating involves "dishonesty or false statement."
choices.D: Yes, because the student "opened the door" to the prosecutor's proof of bad-character evidence.

questions.explanation:
Character evidence on pertinent trait

Criminal Δ may present:
  • Reputation/opinion testimony
Prosecution may rebut by:
Examining its own witness:
  • Reputation/opinion testimony
Cross-examining Δ's witness:
  • Specific instance of conduct
Δ = defendant

A criminal defendant may offer evidence of his/her good character if that trait is pertinent to the crime charged—eg, a defendant's peaceful nature is pertinent to a violent crime. This can be accomplished by calling a character witness to provide reputation or opinion testimony about that character trait. But once this testimony is admitted, the defendant opens the door for the prosecution to rebut it by introducing:

  • reputation or opinion testimony from its own witness about the defendant's pertinent character trait or
  • specific instances of conduct involving that trait—but only while cross-examining the defendant's character witness (ie, no extrinsic evidence).

Here, the student called his professor to testify to the student's excellent reputation for honesty—a character trait pertinent to vehicle theft. This testimony opened the door for the prosecution to offer rebuttal evidence showing the student's bad character for honesty (Choice D). But since evidence that the student had cheated on a college exam is a specific instance of conduct, it can only be admitted on cross-examination of the professor—not through extrinsic evidence like the classmate's testimony. Therefore, the classmate's testimony is inadmissible.

(Choice A) Evidence is probative when it tends to make a material fact more or less probable. Cheating on the exam is probative of the student's character for truthfulness, but it can only be admitted if it complies with other evidentiary rules.

(Choice C) Since the student's cheating involves dishonesty or a false statement, the prosecution can use this evidence to rebut the student's evidence showing his honest character. But the prosecution can only inquire into this specific instance of conduct while cross-examining the professor.

📌 Educational Objective

A criminal defendant may call a character witness to testify about a character trait that is pertinent to the crime charged. If the defendant does so, the prosecution can rebut that evidence by introducing (1) reputation or opinion testimony from any witness or (2) specific instances of conduct while cross-examining the defendant's witness.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 404 (character evidence).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 405 (methods of proving character).

该同学的证词是否可被采纳？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为它对案件中的任何争议点均不具有证明价值。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为只能在对大学教授进行交叉询问时，才能对学生的作弊行为进行质询。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为作弊行为涉及“不诚实或虚假陈述”。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - Character evidence

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：被告先拿品格证据证明“诚实”后，控方能不能用同学的具体行为（specific instance of conduct）直接举证反驳；答案是不能，只能在交叉询问时问。

三秒认题路径：

被告先举品格 → 控方要反驳 → 具体行为 → 只能交叉问 → 不能外证据

核心法律规则

刑事被告可以就与罪名相关的品格特征提出名声证言（reputation testimony）或意见证言（opinion testimony）；考场意思：被告先把“我这个人很诚实”送进场，控方就有机会反击。

但控方反击有边界：可以再拿别人的名声/意见证言来打，也可以问到具体行为（specific instance of conduct），不过后者只能在交叉询问被告的品格证人时问，考场意思：只能“问”，不能再拉一个同学来当外证人。

本题里，作弊是针对诚实品格的具体实例，所以可以问教授，但不能用同学的证言当独立反证。

核心判例： Federal Rule of Evidence 405 的考场逻辑就是：品格一旦被打开，具体行为只能拿来交叉问，不准用来做外部举证。

思维导图

被告先叫教授说“他很诚实”
第一问：这是不是被告主动提出的品格证据？
是
第二问：控方想拿什么来反驳？
具体行为：同学看到作弊
关键卡点：这类证据能不能直接找同学出庭？
不能。具体行为只能在交叉询问教授时问，不能用外部证人做独立证明。
结论：同学的证言被挡在门外，答案选 B

考点陷阱

你可能会想：既然作弊说明他“不诚实”，那控方当然能直接找同学来证明。

但考试真正问的是：这不是在争“能不能反击”，而是在争“反击方式对不对”；司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 B？

题干先由教授证明诚实品格，控方当然能反驳，但specific instance只能拿来交叉问教授，不能让同学直接作外部证言。

❌ 事实误判 | 误读证据用途

✕ A: 把作弊当成和汽车盗窃无关的废话了。

❌ 法律适用 | 例外搬错场景

✕ C: 看到 dishonesty 就想直接收进来，但方式错了。

❌ 概念混淆 | 打开门就能乱上

✕ D: “打开门”只代表能反击，不代表能用任何人来证明。

这题建议用什么方法？

先看证据类型，再看呈现方式：名声/意见能进，具体行为要卡住“只能交叉问”这道门。

考场速记

记住一句：品格先开门，具体行为只许问，不许拉外证人。 看到被告先提诚实、慷慨、和平这类相关品格时，立刻想 reputation/opinion 可以进，specific instance 只能交叉询问。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for kidnapping. The victim has testified that one of the kidnappers referred to the other as "Speed." The prosecutor calls a jail employee to testify that, while the defendant was in jail awaiting trial, other inmates addressed the defendant as "Speed."
Is the jail employee's testimony admissible?

choices.A: No, because it is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.B: No, because it is substantially more prejudicial than probative.
choices.C: Yes, as circumstantial evidence that the defendant was one of the kidnappers.
choices.D: Yes, to support the truthfulness of the victim.

questions.explanation:
Excluding relevant evidence (FRE 403)

Evidence is only admissible if it is relevant—ie, tends to make a material fact more or less probable—and is not barred by other evidentiary rules. For example, Federal Rule of Evidence 403 requires the exclusion of relevant evidence when its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by the danger of any of the following:

  • unfair prejudice – evidence tends to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds
  • confusing the issues – evidence leads the jury to focus on a nonmaterial matter
  • misleading the jury – evidence creates misconceptions in the jurors' minds
  • undue delay or wasting time – presentation of the evidence will cause unnecessary delay or waste time
  • needless cumulation – similar evidence on the same issue has already been admitted

Here, the victim testified that one of the kidnappers referred to the other as "Speed." The jail employee now plans to testify that other inmates called the defendant "Speed." The jail employee's testimony is highly relevant because it provides circumstantial evidence that connects the defendant to the kidnapping—making the material fact that the defendant was a kidnapper more probable. As a result, it is unlikely that the danger of unfair prejudice substantially outweighs the testimony's high probative value, and this testimony should be admitted (Choice B).

(Choice A) Hearsay is an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But the mere use of a person's name or nickname (as seen here) is not a "statement" under this rule because those words are not intended to convey an assertion.

(Choice D) A party may support a witness's character for truthfulness only when (1) that witness's character for truthfulness has been attacked and (2) that support comes in the form of reputation or opinion testimony—neither of which is the case here.

📌 Educational Objective

Federal Rule of Evidence 403 requires the exclusion of relevant evidence when its probative value (ie, degree of relevance) is substantially outweighed by the danger of unfair prejudice, confusing the issues, misleading the jury, undue delay/waste of time, or needless cumulation of evidence.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 401 (test for relevant evidence).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 403 (excluding relevant evidence for certain dangers).

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Relevancy - General Considerations

本题真正考的是

一句话定位考点

本题真正考的是：绰号/称呼能不能作为关联被告身份的间接证据进入法庭，而不是把它误当成传闻或特权问题。

三秒认题路径：

看见“绰号” → 问身份关联 → 先看相关性 → 再过 403 → 选能进

核心法律规则

这题只要抓住两步

相关证据（relevant evidence）只要能让某个重要事实更可能或更不可能，就先有资格进场；这里他在狱中被别人叫作 “Speed”，会让陪审团更容易把他和劫持案里那个“Speed”连起来，所以有相关性。

证据排除规则（FRE 403）不是“有点不舒服就排除”，而是要看 不公平偏见（unfair prejudice）、混淆、误导、拖延等危险是否明显压过证明力；这题里证明力是身份识别，排除门槛没被跨过去。

核心判例： FRE 401 / FRE 403 的基本框架锁定本题：先看是否能帮助证明被告身份，再看是否被明显更大的偏见压过。

思维导图

这不是在问“能不能证明真相的直接说法”，而是在问：绰号能不能帮忙认出被告身份？
第一步：先看是否相关。
“Speed” 让“他就是案中那个人”更可能成立。
第二步：再过 403。
要排除，必须是偏见、混淆等危险明显压过证明力。
结论：这里是身份线索，不是传闻陷阱。
所以选 C：可以作为间接证据证明他是劫匪之一。

考点陷阱

你可能会想：“别人叫他绰号”听起来像在转述别人说过的话，所以是不是 传闻（hearsay）。

但考试真正问的是：这里的重点不是“话内容是真是假”，而是这个称呼本身能不能帮你认人。

司法考试看的是「法律程序上能不能救济」，而不是「物理上的秘密有没有泄露」。同理，这题看的是证据能不能证明身份，不是它听起来像不像故事。

正确答案与干扰项排除

为什么选 C？

题干里“Speed”这一 绰号能把被告和劫持案中的同名者连起来，属于身份识别的间接证据，所以可采。

❌ 概念混淆 | 规则渊源误判

✕ A: 把 nickname 当成传闻陈述，方向错了。

❌ 法律适用 | 403 标准错套

✕ B: 夸大“prejudicial”就想排除，忘了它的证明力更强。

❌ 事实误判 | 证人用途偷换

✕ D: 这不是替 victim truthfulness 背书，而是在认被告身份。

这题建议用什么方法？

先分清“陈述内容”与“称呼线索”，再按相关性和 403 顺序筛一遍。

考场速记

记住：绰号/外号经常不是传闻，而是拿来指认人的线索；先问它是不是让关键事实更可能，再问 403 会不会把它压下去。

口诀：先看相关性，再看 403；能帮你认人，就先别急着踢出场。

questions.subject: Evidence
questions.question: Under the rule allowing exclusion of relevant evidence because its probative value is substantially outweighed by other considerations, which of the following is NOT to be considered?

choices.A: The evidence is likely to arouse unfair prejudice on the part of the jury.
choices.B: The jury may be confused about the appropriate application of the evidence to the issues of the case.
choices.C: The opponent is surprised by the evidence and not fairly prepared to meet it.
choices.D: The trial will be extended and made cumbersome by hearing evidence of relatively trivial consequence.

questions.explanation:
Excluding relevant evidence (FRE 403)

substantially outweighed by
Probative value
  • Unfair prejudice
  • Confusing issues
  • Misleading jury
  • Delay/Waste of time
  • Needlessly cumulative
Certain dangers

Under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 403, a court may exclude relevant evidence if its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of one or more of the following:

  • unfair prejudice – evidence tends to encourage the jury to decide the case on improper grounds (Choice A)
  • confusing the issues – evidence leads the jury to focus on a nonmaterial matter (Choice B)
  • misleading the jury – evidence creates misconceptions in the jurors' minds
  • undue delay or wasting time – presenting the evidence will cause unnecessary delay or waste time (Choice D)
  • needless cumulation – similar evidence on the same issue has already been admitted

Therefore, in applying FRE 403, the court cannot consider whether a party is surprised by the evidence and not fairly prepared to meet it.

📌 Educational Objective

A court may exclude relevant evidence when its probative value is substantially outweighed by a danger of unfair prejudice, confusing the issues, misleading the jury, undue delay, wasting time, or needless cumulation of evidence.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Evid. 403 (exclusion of relevant evidence).
